cuydado: cuydado — care, worry, anxiety (noun; cuydado non ayades 'have no worry'; = cuidado)
perdiestes: perder — you lost (preterite 2nd pl., -stes ending; Buen casamiento perdiestes 'you lost a good marriage'; = perdisteis)
podamos: poder — we may be able (present subjunctive 1st pl.; que vos podamos vengar 'that we may be able to avenge you'; = podamos)
vengar: vengar — to avenge (infinitive; vos podamos vengar 'we may avenge you'; = vengar)
escurriéndolos: escurrir + los — escorting them, seeing them off (gerund + enclitic los; escurriéndolos van 'they keep escorting them'; ir + gerund; the verb is not modern in this sense, cf. acompañar, despedir; sense inferred from the context)
rio: río — river; Rio d'amor 'River of Love', a name Pidal says is unknown today, and which must have lain east of San Esteban de Gormaz (= río)
dándoles: dar + les — giving them (gerund + enclitic dative les; dándoles solaz 'giving them cheer, comfort'; = dándoles)
espidieron: espedirse — they took leave (preterite 3rd pl., with the reflexive se before it: se espidieron dellos 'they took leave of them'; = se despidieron)
alcoçeva: Alcoçeva — a place passed on the way near Gormaz; Pidal: today the 'barranco de Alcoceba', a gully that drains at the very tip of the great bend the Duero makes around Gormaz castle
adiestro: adiestro — on the right hand, to the right (adverb, Latin ad dextrum; adiestro dexan Gormaz 'they leave Gormaz on their right'; = a diestra, a la derecha)
bado: vado — ford (Bado de Rey, spelling b for v; Pidal: today Vadorrey, depopulated, on the left bank of the Duero on the road from Berlanga to Gormaz; = vado)
berlanga: Berlanga — Berlanga de Duero, village and castle on the left bank of the Duero, 13 km from Gormaz and 30 from San Esteban (Pidal; = Berlanga)
métense: meter + se — they set themselves (present 3rd pl. + reflexive; métense a andar 'they set out on their way'; = se ponen a andar)
cena: cena — supper, the evening meal (rica cena 'a rich supper'; = cena)
adeliñechos: adeliñar — heading straight on (irregular past participle masc. pl., a synonym of adeliñado; Pidal 'en derechura'; adeliñechos van 'they go straight on'; = derechos)
ívalas: ir + las — he went (to) them (imperfect 3rd sg. iva + enclitic las; ívalas abraçar 'he went to embrace them'; ir + inf., = las iba a abrazar)
besándolas: besar + las — kissing them (gerund + enclitic las; = besándolas)
tomé: tomar — I took, accepted (preterite 1st sg.; Yo tomé el casamiento 'I accepted the match'; = tomé)
osé: osar — I dared (preterite 1st sg.; non osé dezir al 'I dared say nothing else'; = osé)
besaron: besar — they kissed (preterite 3rd pl.; besaron las manos 'they kissed his hands'; = besaron)
entráronse: entrar + se — they went in (preterite 3rd pl. + enclitic se; entráronse a la cibdad 'they went into the city'; = se entraron)
cibdad: cibdad — city (here Valencia; Latin civitatem; = ciudad)
tardar: tardar — to delay, linger (infinitive; non quiso tardar 'he did not wish to delay'; = tardar)
fablós: fablar + se — he spoke, conferred (preterite fabló + enclitic -s(e), -se reduced to -s as in tornós; fablós con los sos 'he took counsel with his men'; = habló, se habló)
crié: criar — I brought up, reared (preterite 1st sg.; en buen ora te crié 'I reared you in a good hour'; = crié)
lieves: levar — carry, take (2nd sg. command, present subjunctive form with -ie- diphthong, as imperative; Lieves el mandado 'carry the message'; = lleva, lleves)
bésale: besar + le — kiss for him (imperative 2nd sg. + dative le; bésale la mano 'kiss his hand for me'; = bésale)
pese: pesar — may it grieve (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; quel pese al buen rey 'that it may grieve the good king'; Pidal 'ruégale que le pese'; = pese)
casó: casar — he married (off) (preterite 3rd sg.; casó mies fijas 'he married off my daughters'; = casó)
mies: mio — my (fem. pl., Pidal's restoration mi[es]; mies fijas 'my daughters'; = mis)
di: dar — I gave (strong preterite 1st sg.; non gelas di yo 'I did not give them (to them)'; = di)
desonor: desonor — dishonour, shame (fem. here, la otra desonor, a grant desonor; des- + onor; = deshonor)
cabe: caber — there lies, there is room (present 3rd sg., 'there falls (to us)'; desondra y cabe 'if there is dishonour in this'; = cabe)
poca: poco — little, small (fem. sg. used as a noun; la poca e la grant 'the small and the great (part of the dishonour)'; = poca)
levado: levar — taken away (past part. masc. sg.; se me an levado 'they have carried off from me'; = llevado)
adúgamelos: aduzir + me + los — let him bring them to me (present subjunctive 3rd sg. used as a command, + dative me + object los; Adúgamelos a vistas 'let him bring them to me at a meeting'; = tráigamelos, que me los traiga)
juntas: junta — meeting, assembly (fem. pl.; a vistas o a juntas 'to interviews or meetings'; = juntas)
asturias: Asturias — Asturias, the northern kingdom, here part of Alfonso's lands (de las Asturias bien a San Çalvador; = Asturias)
çalvador: Salvador — San Çalvador, i.e. Oviedo, capital of Asturias, so called from its cathedral dedicated to the Saviour (Pidal; = San Salvador)
yaguo: Yaguo — Santi Yaguo, Santiago, i.e. the city of Santiago de Galicia (Pidal; = Santiago)
gallizanos: gallizano — Galician (masc. pl. adj.; comdes gallizanos 'Galician counts'; = gallegos)
omillós: omillar + se — he bowed down, saluted reverently (preterite omilló + enclitic -s(e); omillós a los santos 'he bowed to the saints'; Pidal 'saludó reverentemente'; = se humilló)
aguardan: aguardar — they attend, escort, serve (present 3rd pl.; quel aguardan cum a sseñor 'who attend him as their lord'; = aguardan, here closest sirven, acompañan)
sseñor: señor — lord (ss spelling for the s sound at the start of the word; cum a sseñor 'as to a lord'; = señor)
coñosció: conoscer — he recognized (preterite 3rd sg., ñ for n; = conoció, reconoció)
levantós: levantar + se — he rose (preterite levantó + enclitic -s(e); levantós el rey 'the king rose'; = se levantó)
besábale: besar + le — he was kissing (imperfect 3rd sg. + dative le, of a possessor; besábale los piedes 'he kissed his feet'; = le besaba)
reynos: reyno — kingdom (masc. pl.; de largos reynos 'of many kingdoms'; = reinos)
besa: besar — he kisses (present 3rd sg.; vos besa las manos 'he kisses your hands'; = besa)
casastes: casar — you married (off) (preterite 2nd pl., -stes ending, said to the king; Casastes sus fijas 'you married off his daughters'; = casasteis)
quisiestes: querer — you wished (strong preterite 2nd pl., -stes; ca lo quisiestes vos 'since you wished it'; = quisisteis)
cuntida: cuntir — befallen, come to pass (past part. fem., ser + part.; la ondra que es cuntida a nos 'the honour that has come to us', said bitterly; = acaecida, ocurrida)
infantes: infante — young nobleman, son of a noble house (pl., written with lower-case i; infantes de Carrión; = infantes)
desenparadas: desenparar — abandoned (past part. fem. pl.; desenparadas las dexaron 'they left them abandoned'; = desamparadas)
afélas: afé + las — behold them, there they are (afé, a presentative 'behold', + enclitic las; Afélas sus fijas en Valençia 'here are his daughters in Valencia'; no modern verb, = helas aquí)
desondrado: desondrar — dishonoured (past part. masc. sg.; tienes por desondrado 'he holds himself dishonoured'; = deshonrado)
calló: callar — he fell silent (preterite 3rd sg.; calló e comidió 'he fell silent and pondered'; = calló)
dizes: dezir — you say (present 2nd sg.; verdad dizes 'you speak the truth'; = dices)
casé: casar — I married (off) (preterite 1st sg.; yo casé sus fijas 'I married off his daughters'; = casé)
fizlo: fazer + lo — I did it (strong preterite 1st sg. fiz + enclitic lo; fizlo por bien 'I did it for the best'; = lo hice)
ffosse: seer — it might be (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg.; ff- is an initial spelling of f, Pidal's ff[o]sse; que ffosse a su pro 'that it might be to their advantage'; = fuese)
pésanos: pesar + nos — it grieves us (present 3rd sg. + enclitic dative nos; Entre yo e mio Çid pésanos 'it grieves us both, me and my Cid'; = nos pesa)
lê: le + é — (I shall) help him: ayudar lê = ayudar le + é (e = aver, 1st sg., the split future, Pidal prints lê; Ayudar lê a derecho 'I shall help him to justice'; = le ayudaré)
sín: sín — so, in the oath sín salve el Criador 'so may the Creator save'; sí 'so, thus' (optative particle) with an enclitic, apparently an -n; the exact enclitic is uncertain (probably a pronoun, 'me'); the sense is a solemn adjuration 'so help me the Creator'
cuydava: cuydar — he thought, intended (imperfect 3rd sg.; lo que non cuydava fer 'what he did not intend to do'; = cuidaba, pensaba)
andarán: andar — they will go about, travel (future 3rd pl.; andarán mios porteros 'my heralds will go about'; = andarán)
porteros: portero — doorkeeper, usher, herald (masc. pl.; Pidal: the portero is the one charged with summoning a court; porteros por todo el reyno 'heralds throughout the kingdom'; = porteros)
toledo: Toledo — Toledo, the city on the Tajo, where the king will hold the summoned court (= Toledo)
pregonarán: pregonar — they will proclaim, announce publicly (future 3rd pl.; pregonarán mie cort 'they will cry my court'; Pidal: corte pregonada is a solemn court; = pregonarán)
podiéndolo: poder + lo — being able (to prevent) it (gerund + enclitic lo; podiéndolo vedar yo 'when I can prevent it'; = pudiéndolo)

__broaden__.otro: otro — other, another (masc.; el otro 'the other'; = otro) · also otro día 'the next day'; lo otro 'the rest' · also otro tanto 'just as much, likewise' (Pidal calls the line difficult: e Per Vermudoz otro tanto las ha 'and Pero Vermúdez likewise')
__broaden__.él: él — he (stressed subject pronoun) · also él — 'him, it' after a preposition, of a thing (a él vino; en él fincaredes 'in it', i.e. in Castejón) · also él — 'him' after a preposition, of a person (con él dos cavalleros 'with him two knights')
__broaden__.bien: bien — well · bien — good, benefit (noun; algún bien vos pueda far 'some good I may do you') · bien — very, quite, intensifying an adverb (bien çerca del agua 'very near the water') · also bien — 'right, all the way' before a preposition of place (de las Asturias bien a San Çalvador 'as far as San Salvador')
__broaden__.ellos: ellos — they, them (stressed 3rd pl. masc. pronoun) · also ellos — 'those, the' (demonstrative/article with a noun; ellos comdes gallizanos 'those Galician counts')
__broaden__.assí: assí — thus, so (= así) · also assí — so greatly, so much (Pidal 'de tal modo, mucho'; assí envergonçó 'was so abashed') · also assí commo 'as soon as' (Assí commo descavalga 'as soon as he dismounts'; = así como, en cuanto)
__broaden__.contra: contra — toward, facing, in the direction of (= hacia; contra la sierra 'facing the sierra') · also contra — 'against, directed at' (desondra … contra nos 'dishonour against us'; = contra)
__broaden__.largos: largo — abundant, ample, generous (masc. pl.; averes largos 'plentiful goods'; = largos) · also largos — 'many, wide, extensive' (de largos reynos 'of many kingdoms', Pidal 'muchos reinos'; = muchos, vastos)
__broaden__.quier: querer — (he) wishes (present 3rd sg. without -e, subjunctive in value; qui quier 'whoever, anyone at all', = quienquiera; = quiera) · also si quier — 'would that, if only' (¡Si quier el casamiento fecho non fosse oy! 'would that the match had never been made today', Pidal 'ojalá'; = ojalá)
__broaden__.levedes: levar — you take, carry (2nd pl., -edes; here a command, tres mill moros levedes 'take three thousand Moors'; probably present subjunctive used as imperative; = llevad) · also levedes — 'you bring' (present subjunctive 2nd pl. after que, 'that you bring them'; que gelos levedes a vistas 'that you bring them to a meeting for him'; = llevéis, traigáis)
__broaden__.quomo: commo — as (variant spelling, Pidal's Qu[o]mo; = como) · also quomo — 'how' (qu[o]mo nos han abiltados 'how they have shamed us')
__broaden__.sazón: sazón — due season, prime condition; de sazón 'in good condition, fit' (palafré de sazón 'a palfrey in prime condition', probably; = sazón) · also sazón — time, season, period (toda esta sazón 'all this time'; Pidal; = tiempo)
__broaden__.den: den — from there, from it (de + en, the short form of ende 'thence', as dent = de + ent; non pueden den quitar 'they cannot get clear of it'; = de allí, de ello) · also den — they give (present subjunctive 3rd pl. of dar; commo den derecho 'that they give justice'; = den)
__broaden__.desnudas: desnudo — bare, drawn (fem. pl., of swords; = desnudas) · also desnudas — naked, stripped (of persons, fem. pl.; majadas e desnudas 'beaten and stripped'; = desnudas)
